_notes: One entry per measure: unit, period type and an ordered priority list of XBRL concepts. The first concept with a value for a fiscal year wins, year by year. An object {"sum": [...]} is an explicit derived value (all parts must exist). Reviewed against the 5 fixtures; see docs/coverage_report.md.

revenue._notes: Companies switch tags over time (GOOGL, TSLA, DUK). Banks tag total net revenue as Revenues (JPM). SalesRevenueGoodsNet is last so it only fills years nothing else covers (KO 2007-2017).

net_income._notes: NetIncomeLoss is attributable to the parent; ProfitLoss includes noncontrolling interests, so it is only a fallback.

eps_diluted._notes: TSLA used BasicAndDiluted in its loss-making years.

current_assets._notes: Banks do not report a classified balance sheet, so JPM is a gap.

long_term_debt._notes: Non-current portion first (Graham's test is on long-term debt). LongTermDebt includes the current portion, so it is a last resort.

stockholders_equity._notes: Parent shareholders' equity first, to match parent net income in ROE.

operating_income._notes: Banks do not report operating income (JPM is a gap).

depreciation_amortization._notes: Alphabet tags total D&A with a company extension that companyfacts omits, so it is mostly a gap. Last resort (ADR-030): Depreciation alone, flagged derived with a note, used only when nothing else covers the year; it understates D&A, which errs conservative for owner earnings.

capex._notes: Cash outflow, reported as a positive number.

dividends_paid._notes: Cash paid on common stock; PaymentsOfDividends is the generic tag KO, JPM and DUK use. DUK switched to PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends in 2021.

dividends_per_share._notes: CashPaid first, Declared as the per-year fallback (ADR-060). G4 asks whether a dividend was PAID. Prologis tags a small amount ($0.00 to $0.03 a year) as Declared and the real dividend ($1.76 to $4.04) as CashPaid, so Declared-first made G4 fail in 5 years in which it paid. KO reports only CashPaid.
